Core definitions of the composed CLI game: wire parsers, driver, KeyInd handler, cost budgets

Trusted: definitions used by the statement. Every declaration in this file lies in the closure of Computational/Theorems/Main.lean (via Computational/Specifications/Game/StatementPq.lean, Computational/Specifications/LibsignalCli/StatementPqElf.lean, and Computational/Specifications/Reductions/Pqxdh/StatementPqReds.lean). See Computational/docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

Non-ELF building blocks of the composed PQXDH + Double Ratchet security game played against the libsignal CLI binary (StatementPq.lean). The bh / BH ("binary harness") prefix denotes the game in which sessions carry wire-byte state (BinState) rather than abstract model state (GhostState Bytes). The adversary interacts with four oracle families: uniform coins, the PQXDH key-indistinguishability game KeyInd, the session-promotion control oracle startDR sid, and per-instance ACD19 secure-messaging (SM) oracles; the driver mirrors the public KeyInd transcript, guards promotion, and runs each promoted instance as an SM game.

This file also connects the composed game specifications (bhGameSpec, bhTargetGameSpec) to the ReductionDsl operation tables and codecs of AtomicOps.lean and TargetCodecs.lean, and defines the closed-form step-cost budgets bhAdapterCostBudget (for the wire-to-model adapter) and bhE2ECostBudget (for the multi-session composition reductions in StatementPqReds.lean), along with their online/offline per-kind counterparts bhAdapterCostBudgetByKind and bhE2ECostBudgetByKind.

Canonical tag-3 PreKeySignalMessage wire parser (DEV-C18)

def bhReadProstVarintL59–64 ↗#

Decode one LEB128 varint, returning (value, remainingBytes).

def bhReadProstVarint : List (BitVec 8) → Option (ℕ × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => none | b :: rest => if b.toNat < 128 then some (b.toNat, rest) else (bhReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (hi, rest') => (b.toNat - 128 + 128 * hi, rest'))

def bhParseOptPreKeyIdL66–71 ↗#

Parse optional protobuf field 1 (preKeyId, tag 0x08#8).

def bhParseOptPreKeyId : List (BitVec 8) → Option (Option UInt32 × List (BitVec 8)) | [] => some (none, []) | b :: rest => if b == 0x08#8 then (bhReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (n, r) => (some (UInt32.ofNat n), r)) else some (none, b :: rest)

def bhParseUint32FieldL73–77 ↗#

Parse a required uint32 varint field with tag byte keyByte.

def bhParseUint32Field (keyByte : BitVec 8) : List (BitVec 8) → Option (UInt32 × List (BitVec 8)) | k :: rest => if k == keyByte then (bhReadProstVarint rest).map (fun (n, r) => (UInt32.ofNat n, r)) else none | [] => none

def bhParseDjbKeyFieldL79–84 ↗#

Parse a 33-byte DJB Curve25519 public-key field (type byte 0x05#8) with tag keyByte.

def bhParseDjbKeyField (keyByte : BitVec 8) : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8) × List (BitVec 8)) | k :: 0x21#8 :: 0x05#8 :: rest => if k == keyByte && decide (32 ≤ rest.length) then some (rest.take 32, rest.drop 32) else none | _ => none

def bhParseInnerMsgFieldWithRestL86–91 ↗#

Parse length-delimited field 4 (message, tag 0x22#8), returning (inner, rest).

def bhParseInnerMsgFieldWithRest : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8) × List (BitVec 8)) | 0x22#8 :: rest => (bhReadProstVarint rest).bind (fun (len, afterLen) => if decide (len ≤ afterLen.length) then some (afterLen.take len, afterLen.drop len) else none) | _ => none

def bhParseKyberCtFieldL93–97 ↗#

Parse field 8 (kyberCiphertext, tag 0x42#8, length 1569, type byte 0x08#8).

def bhParseKyberCtField : List (BitVec 8) → Option (List (BitVec 8)) | 0x42#8 :: 0xa1#8 :: 0x0c#8 :: 0x08#8 :: rest => if decide (1568 ≤ rest.length) then some (rest.take 1568) else none | _ => none

def bhHdrOfPreKeyMsgL99–102 ↗#

Extract the PQXDH HandshakeHdr from PreKeyMessageFields.

def bhHdrOfPreKeyMsg (m : PreKeyMessageFields) : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr := { ikAPk := vecU8 m.idPub, ekAPk := vecU8 m.baseKey, spkId := u32 m.spkId, opkId? := m.opkId.map u32, pqspkId := u32 m.kpkId, kemCt := vecU8 m.kyberCt }

def bhDecodePreKeyMsgERawL104–124 ↗#

Parse a tag-3 PreKeySignalMessage wire buffer without checking canonical re-encoding.

def bhDecodePreKeyMsgERaw : Bytes → Option PreKeyMessageFields | t :: v :: proto => if t == wirePrekey && v == versionByte currentVersion then (bhParseOptPreKeyId proto).bind fun (opkId?, after1) => (bhParseDjbKeyField 0x12#8 after1).bind fun (bkBytes, after2) => (bhParseDjbKeyField 0x1a#8 after2).bind fun (idBytes, after3) => (bhParseInnerMsgFieldWithRest after3).bind fun (inner, after4) => (bhParseUint32Field 0x28#8 after4).bind fun (regId, after5) => (bhParseUint32Field 0x30#8 after5).bind fun (spkId, after6) => (bhParseUint32Field 0x38#8 after6).bind fun (pqspkId, after7) => (bhParseKyberCtField after7).bind fun kemCtBytes => if hbk : bkBytes.length = 32 then if hid : idBytes.length = 32 then if hct : kemCtBytes.length = 1568 then some { regId := regId.toBitVec, opkId := opkId?.map UInt32.toBitVec, spkId := spkId.toBitVec, kpkId := pqspkId.toBitVec, kyberCt := ⟨kemCtBytes, hct⟩, baseKey := ⟨bkBytes, hbk⟩, idPub := ⟨idBytes, hid⟩, inner := inner } else none else none else none else none | _ => none

def bhDecodePreKeyMsgEL126–129 ↗#

Parse a canonical tag-3 PreKeySignalMessage wire buffer (wirePrekey :: m.bytes).

def bhDecodePreKeyMsgE (c : Bytes) : Option PreKeyMessageFields := match bhDecodePreKeyMsgERaw c with | some m => if c == wirePrekey :: m.bytes then some m else none | none => none

def mkMeEStrictL154–157 ↗#

Build LocalIdentity for principal u, failing unless secIKA0 has 32 bytes.

def mkMeEStrict (u : ℕ) (secIKA0 : SignalPqxdh.Bytes) : Option LocalIdentity := do let idPriv ← fitU8VecStrict 32 secIKA0 some { regId := BitVec.ofNat 32 u, idPriv := idPriv }

def mkKeysEStrictL159–169 ↗#

Build ResponderPreKeySecrets for slot index j, failing on any key-length mismatch.

def mkKeysEStrict (j : ℕ) (bEntry : SignalPqxdh.SpkBundleEntry) (opk? : Option (ℕ × SignalPqxdh.Bytes)) : Option ResponderPreKeySecrets := do let spkPriv ← fitU8VecStrict 32 bEntry.spkSk let kpkPub ← fitU8VecStrict 1568 bEntry.pqspkPk let kpkSec ← fitU8VecStrict 3168 bEntry.pqspkSk let opkV ← match opk? with | none => some none | some (o, sk) => do let v ← fitU8VecStrict 32 sk; some (some (BitVec.ofNat 32 o, v)) some { spkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 j, spkPriv := spkPriv, opk := opkV, kpkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 j, kpkPub := kpkPub, kpkSec := kpkSec }

def mkBundleEStrictL171–184 ↗#

Build PreKeyBundleFields for registration ID u, failing on any key- or signature-length mismatch.

def mkBundleEStrict (u : ℕ) (bnd : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) : Option PreKeyBundleFields := do let spkPub ← fitU8VecStrict 32 bnd.spkB let spkSig ← fitU8VecStrict 64 bnd.spkSig let kpkPub ← fitU8VecStrict 1568 bnd.pqspkB let kpkSig ← fitU8VecStrict 64 bnd.pqspkSig let idPub ← fitU8VecStrict 32 bnd.ikB let opkV ← match bnd.opkB? with | none => some none | some (id, pk) => do let v ← fitU8VecStrict 32 pk; some (some (BitVec.ofNat 32 id.toNat, v)) some { regId := BitVec.ofNat 32 u, opk := opkV, spkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 bnd.spkId.toNat, spkPub := spkPub, spkSig := spkSig, kpkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 bnd.pqspkId.toNat, kpkPub := kpkPub, kpkSig := kpkSig, idPub := idPub }

Tag-3 routing, in-transit alignment, and injection filter

(DEV-C11, DEV-C18, DEV-C19)

def bhExpectedPreKeyMsgL189–196 ↗#

Canonical PreKeyMessageFields expected from initiator regIdA with header hdr and payload inner (DEV-C11).

def bhExpectedPreKeyMsg (regIdA : BitVec 32) (hdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) (inner : Bytes) : PreKeyMessageFields := { regId := regIdA, opkId := hdr.opkId?.map (fun id => BitVec.ofNat 32 id.toNat), spkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 hdr.spkId.toNat, kpkId := BitVec.ofNat 32 hdr.pqspkId.toNat, kyberCt := u8Vec SignalPqxdh.kyberCtLen hdr.kemCt, baseKey := u8Vec 32 hdr.ekAPk, idPub := u8Vec 32 hdr.ikAPk, inner := inner }

def bhWireInnerBytesL198–202 ↗#

Extract the inner SignalMessage bytes from a canonical tag-3 or tag-2 wire message.

def bhWireInnerBytes (c : Bytes) : Option Bytes := match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => some m.inner | none => match c with | t :: body => if t == wireWhisper then some body else none | [] => none

def bhPartneredInnerBytesL204–220 ↗#

Extract the inner SignalMessage bytes of a wire c partnered with (regIdA, sessionHdr) (DEV-C11, DEV-C18, DEV-C19): requires a byte-exact canonical PreKeySignalMessage before Bob's first accept, and either a header-matching PreKeySignalMessage or a tag-2 SignalMessage thereafter.

def bhPartneredInnerBytes (bobAccepted : Bool) (regIdA : BitVec 32) (sessionHdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) (c : Bytes) : Option Bytes := if !bobAccepted then match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => if c == wirePrekey :: (bhExpectedPreKeyMsg regIdA sessionHdr m.inner).bytes then some m.inner else none | none => none else match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => if bhHdrOfPreKeyMsg m == sessionHdr then some m.inner else none | none => match c with | t :: body => if t == wireWhisper then some body else none | [] => none

def bhAlignTransListL222–229 ↗#

Rewrite the first Alice in-transit record with inner SignalMessage inner to outer wire c.

def bhAlignTransList {Msg : Type} (inner c : Bytes) : List (SM.Record Msg Bytes) → List (SM.Record Msg Bytes) | [] => [] | r :: rest => if r.pos.sender == .A && bhWireInnerBytes r.ct == some inner then { r with ct := c } :: rest else r :: bhAlignTransList inner c rest

def bhAlignTransForBobL231–241 ↗#

Align gs.trans on post-accept deliver-B(c) so a re-wrapped pre-key wire matches Alice's in-transit inner SignalMessage (DEV-C11, DEV-C18); pre-accept deliveries require byte-exact outer-wire matching.

def bhAlignTransForBob {St Msg : Type} (bobAccepted : Bool) (regIdA : BitVec 32) (sessionHdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) (c : Bytes) (gs : SM.GameState St Msg Bytes) : SM.GameState St Msg Bytes := if !bobAccepted then gs else match bhPartneredInnerBytes true regIdA sessionHdr c with | some inner => { gs with trans := bhAlignTransList inner c gs.trans } | none => gs

def bhPartneredInTransitAL243–250 ↗#

Whether c is partnered with (regIdA, sessionHdr) and carries inner SignalMessage bytes currently in transit from Alice.

def bhPartneredInTransitA {St Msg : Type} (bobAccepted : Bool) (regIdA : BitVec 32) (sessionHdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) (c : Bytes) (gs : SM.GameState St Msg Bytes) : Bool := match bhPartneredInnerBytes bobAccepted regIdA sessionHdr c with | some inner => gs.trans.any (fun r => r.pos.sender == .A && bhWireInnerBytes r.ct == some inner) | none => false

def bhInjOKL252–265 ↗#

Ciphertext injection filter for the binary-harness SM game (DEV-PQ10, DEV-CLI14, DEV-CLI21, DEV-LS5): requires c.length ≤ stdinCapBytes, shortCiphertext c, inner payload length < 2 ^ 32 - 2048 on canonical tag-3 wires, and ratchetKeyAdmissible on the inner SignalMessage.

def bhInjOK {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (c : Bytes) : Bool := decide (c.length ≤ stdinCapBytes) && shortCiphertext c && match bhDecodePreKeyMsgE c with | some m => decide (m.inner.length + 2048 < 2 ^ 32) && ratchetKeyAdmissible protoSignalCodec decT encT m.inner | none => match c with | t :: body => t == wireWhisper && ratchetKeyAdmissible protoSignalCodec decT encT body | [] => false

def bhConfigSpkSL267–271 ↗#

SM.ConfigR of a binary-harness instance: configRefuseEarlyBobCorr with injection filter bhInjOK.

def bhConfigSpkS {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) {Msg : Type} : SM.ConfigR BinState Msg Bytes := { configRefuseEarlyBobCorr decT encT with injOK := bhInjOK decT encT }

structure ModelDriverInstanceMetaL322–340 ↗#

Per-instance freshness and responder-slot metadata.

DEV-C17 (formalization): initiator-identity freshness at Bob's first accept, and no adversary revealSpkSk. In KeyInd, initiator freshness (isKeyIndInitStillFresh) inspects only the responder's keys, whereas Bob's handshake binds ikA only via DH(spkB_sk, ikA). Corrupting ikA or revealing spkB_sk before Bob's first accept would let an adversary forge a pre-key message under ikA while Alice's session remains KeyInd-fresh (DEV-PQ24). Each promoted instance records whether Bob has accepted (bobAccepted), whether ikA was corrupted at that first accept (ikACorrAtAccept), and its responder slot (respPrin, respSpkIdx), while revealedSpks logs adversarial revealSpkSk queries (excluding the driver's own reveal at startDR, DEV-C10). Once bhDrvInstClean (or bhE2EDrvInstClean) fails for instance i, SM queries on i return none without affecting other instances. Effect: restricts the adversary.

structure ModelDriverInstanceMeta (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) where bobAccepted : Bool := false ikACorrAtAccept : Bool := false respPrin : Option (Fin S.N_id) := none respSpkIdx : Option (Fin S.N_recv) := none instOpkId? : Option UInt32 := none deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def bhDrvAcceptIkOkL373–386 ↗#

Byte-exact ikA pin on responder accepts.

DEV-C15 (formalization): byte-exact identity pins on KeyInd handshake queries, and no revealDhSecrets. KeyInd matches identity keys modulo the cofactor projection P.pow8, so an 8-torsion twin ikA + T of a mirrored honest principal's key passes acceptOPK / acceptNoOPK and consumes the responder's pre-key slot and Kyber replay tuple. The driver forwards a responder accept only if hdr.ikAPk is byte-equal to a mirrored principal key (bhDrvAcceptIkOk), and an initiateOPK / initiateNoOPK only if no mirrored principal key is a distinct pow8-twin of bnd.ikB (bhDrvInitiateIkOk); the signed pre-key is checked byte-for-byte at startDR (DEV-C9). bhDrvKiQueryOk also refuses revealDhSecrets (DEV-PQ19, DEV-PQ23) and testSession (DEV-C12). Effect: restricts the adversary.

def bhDrvAcceptIkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (hdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr) : Bool := ds.prins.any (fun e => e.2 == hdr.ikAPk)

def bhDrvInitiateIkOkL388–392 ↗#

Reject bundles whose ikB is a distinct pow8-twin of a mirrored honest principal key (DEV-C19).

def bhDrvInitiateIkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (bnd : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool := !ds.prins.any (fun (_, pk) => P.pow8 pk == P.pow8 bnd.ikB && pk != bnd.ikB)

def bhDrvKiQueryOkL394–401 ↗#

Admissibility filter on KeyIndQuery in the composed game (DEV-C12, DEV-C15, DEV-C19).

def bhDrvKiQueryOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (ds : ModelDriverBase S) : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S → Bool | .testSession _ | .revealDhSecrets => false | .initiateOPK _ _ bnd => bnd.opkB?.isSome && bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds bnd | .initiateNoOPK _ _ bnd => bnd.opkB?.isNone && bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds bnd | .acceptOPK _ _ _ hdr | .acceptNoOPK _ _ _ hdr => bhDrvAcceptIkOk ds hdr | _ => true

def bhNoOpkRespPromotedL403–410 ↗#

Whether u is the responder of a promoted no-OPK instance (respPrin = some u and instOpkId? = none). Because startDR reveals the responder's signed pre-key (DEV-C10), a subsequent corruptIK u on a no-OPK session would violate isKeyIndInitStillFresh and void the entire run via allTestedSessionsFresh; the composed drivers therefore refuse corruptIK u once this holds, complementing the !corrPrins.contains u check in bhDrvGuard.

def bhNoOpkRespPromoted {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (instMeta : List (ModelDriverInstanceMeta S)) (u : Fin S.N_id) : Bool := instMeta.any (fun im => im.respPrin == some u && im.instOpkId?.isNone)

def bhInstIkACorruptedL412–417 ↗#

Whether the initiator identity key ikA of bi belongs to a corrupted principal (DEV-C17).

def bhInstIkACorrupted {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S ℓ) : Bool := (match bhDrvSessionInitPrin? bi.sid with | some u => ds.corrPrins.contains u | none => true) || ds.prins.any (fun (u, pk) => pk == bi.hdr.ikAPk && ds.corrPrins.contains u)

def bhDrvInstCleanL419–427 ↗#

Per-instance cleanliness check on ModelDriverState (DEV-C17): requires an initiator principal, uncorrupted ikA at Bob's first accept, and no adversarial revealSpkSk on bi.respSlot.

def bhDrvInstClean {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (i : ℕ) : Bool := match ds.bhInsts[i]?, ds.instMeta[i]? with | some bi, some im => (bhDrvSessionInitPrin? bi.sid).isSome && !im.ikACorrAtAccept && !ds.revealedSpks.contains bi.respSlot | _, _ => true

def allTestedSessionsFreshL429–438 ↗#

End-of-game freshness predicate requiring every tested initiator and responder session in st to remain fresh (DEV-C10).

def allTestedSessionsFresh {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (st : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndState S) : Bool := st.sessions.all (fun s => !s.tested || SignalPqxdh.isKeyIndInitStillFresh P true st.principals st.spkBundles st.respSessions s) && st.respSessions.all (fun r => !r.tested || SignalPqxdh.isKeyIndRespStillFresh P true st.principals st.spkBundles st.sessions r)

def driverSomeInstanceWonL440–442 ↗#

Whether some promoted instance in ds with challenge bit b has gs.win = true.

def driverSomeInstanceWon {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (b : Bool) : Bool := ds.bhInsts.any (fun bi => match bi.gs with | some gs => gs.b == b && gs.win | none => false)

def bhBaseMirrorL444–458 ↗#

Record public keys, bundles, OPKs, and initiator headers from a KeyInd step in ModelDriverBase.

def bhBaseMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : ModelDriverBase S := match q, r with | .initPrin u, .initPrinResp ikPk _ => { ds with prins := (u, ikPk) :: ds.prins } | .genSPK u j, .bundleResp bnd => { ds with bundles := ((u, j), (bnd.spkB, bnd.pqspkB)) :: ds.bundles } | .genOPK u j o, .pkResp opkPk => { ds with opks := ((u, j, o), opkPk) :: ds.opks } | .initiateOPK u i bnd, .hdrResp hdr => { ds with sends := (.sendOPK u i, bnd, hdr) :: ds.sends } | .initiateNoOPK u i bnd, .hdrResp hdr => { ds with sends := (.sendNoOPK u i, bnd, hdr) :: ds.sends } | _, _ => ds

def bhDrvMirrorL460–470 ↗#

Extend bhBaseMirror on ModelDriverState with corrupted principals and adversarially revealed SPK slots.

def bhDrvMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : ModelDriverState S ℓ := let dsBase := bhBaseMirror ds.toModelDriverBase q r let corrPrins' := match q, r with | .corruptIK u, .corrResp _ _ => u :: ds.corrPrins | _, _ => ds.corrPrins let revSpks' := match q, r with | .revealSpkSk u j, .spkSkResp _ => (u, j) :: ds.revealedSpks | _, _ => ds.revealedSpks { ds with toModelDriverBase := dsBase, corrPrins := corrPrins', revealedSpks := revSpks' }

def bhBaseOpkOkL472–481 ↗#

Whether bnd.opkB? matches a mirrored OPK of responder slot (u, j) (DEV-C20).

def bhBaseOpkOk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} (ds : ModelDriverBase S) (u : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (bnd : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool := match bnd.opkB? with | none => true | some (opkId, opkPk) => ds.opks.any (fun ((u', j', o), pk) => u' == u && j' == j && UInt32.ofNat o.val == opkId && o.val == opkId.toNat && pk == opkPk)

def bhDrvGuardL483–507 ↗#

Session-promotion guard for startDR sid (DEV-C9, DEV-C10, DEV-C20): checks uniqueness of sid and ekAPk, matches the bundle and optional OPK against mirrored honest keys of some slot (u, j), and for no-OPK handshakes requires !ds.corrPrins.contains u.

def bhDrvGuard {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) : Option (SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr × SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput × (Fin S.N_id × Fin S.N_recv)) := if ds.bhInsts.any (fun bi => bi.sid == sid) then none else match ds.sends.find? (fun (s, _, _) => s == sid) with | none => none | some (_, bnd, hdr) => if ds.bhInsts.any (fun bi => bi.hdr.ekAPk == hdr.ekAPk) then none else match ds.bundles.find? (fun ((_, j), (spkB, pqspkB)) => spkB == bnd.spkB && pqspkB == bnd.pqspkB && hdr.spkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val && hdr.pqspkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val) with | none => none | some ((u, j), _) => if ds.prins.any (fun (u', pk) => u' == u && pk == bnd.ikB) && bhBaseOpkOk ds.toModelDriverBase u j bnd && (bnd.opkB?.isSome || !ds.corrPrins.contains u) then some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)) else none

abbrev BHDrvModeL509–512 ↗#

Instance challenge-bit selector (none for an external SM instance, some b for bit b).

abbrev BHDrvMode (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) := SignalPqxdh.SessionId S → (Fin S.N_id × Fin S.N_recv) → SignalPqxdh.Bytes → SignalPqxdh.Bytes → SignalPqxdh.Bytes → Option Bool

abbrev BHDrvML514–515 ↗#

abbrev BHDrvM (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) := StateT (ModelDriverState S ℓ) (StateT (SignalPqxdh.KeyIndState S) ProbComp)

def bhRunInitiateL517–562 ↗#

Execute a KeyInd initiator handshake from a uniform 160-byte tape t_init (using a lazy random oracle when useRo = true and concrete HKDF when useRo = false), recording t_init in ds.initTapes.

def bhRunInitiate (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) {ℓ : ℕ} (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) (u : Fin S.N_id) (bundle : SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput) (useRo : Bool := false) : BHDrvM S ℓ SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse := do let st ← StateT.lift get if st.sessions.any (fun e => e.sid == sid) then return .noneResp let some (_, uEntry) := st.principals.find? (fun (idx, _) => idx == u.val) | return .noneResp if !(match SignalPqxdh.findHonestPrincipal P st.principals bundle.ikB with | some (_, e) => e.ikAPk == bundle.ikB | none => true) then return .noneResp if !SignalPqxdh.koskBundleOk P st.principals st.spkBundles st.opkEntries st.advKeys bundle then return .noneResp let t_init ← StateT.lift (liftM ($ᵗ List.Vector (BitVec 8) 160)) let ekASk := tapeEkASk t_init; let kemCoins := tapeKemCoins t_init let sigPkB := SignalPqxdh.resolveSigPk P st.principals bundle.ikB if !(P.sigVerify sigPkB (SignalPqxdh.encodeEC bundle.spkB) bundle.spkSig && P.sigVerify sigPkB (SignalPqxdh.encodeKEM bundle.pqspkB) bundle.pqspkSig) then return .noneResp let some (ss, kemCt) := P.kemEncaps bundle.pqspkB kemCoins | return .noneResp let ekAPk := P.x25519Base ekASk let dh1 := P.x25519 uEntry.secIKA0 bundle.spkB; let dh2 := P.x25519 ekASk bundle.ikB let dh3 := P.x25519 ekASk bundle.spkB let dh4? := bundle.opkB?.map (fun (_, opkPk) => P.x25519 ekASk opkPk) let secrets := SignalPqxdh.buildSecrets dh1 dh2 dh3 dh4? ss let (drKeyReal, roCache') ← StateT.lift (liftM (SignalPqxdh.evalHkdfOrRo useRo P st.roCache secrets)) let hdr : SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr := { ikAPk := uEntry.ikAPk, ekAPk := ekAPk, spkId := bundle.spkId, opkId? := bundle.opkB?.map Prod.fst, pqspkId := bundle.pqspkId, kemCt := kemCt } let honestPeer := SignalPqxdh.isHonestUncorruptedPeer P st.principals bundle.ikB let (spkHon, opkHon, pqspkHon) := SignalPqxdh.checkBundleProvenance P st.principals st.spkBundles st.opkEntries bundle let sessEntry : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndInitiatorEntry S := { sid := sid, honestPeer := honestPeer, peerIkPk := bundle.ikB, peerSpkPk := bundle.spkB, peerOpkPk? := bundle.opkB?.map Prod.snd, peerPqspkPk := bundle.pqspkB, spkHonest := spkHon, opkHonest := opkHon, pqspkHonest := pqspkHon, ekASk := ekASk, fresh := honestPeer.isSome, drKeyReal := drKeyReal, drKeyRand := drKeyReal, hdr := hdr, tested := false } let drKeyRand ← match SignalPqxdh.keyIndPartnerRandKey? P st.respSessions sessEntry with | some dk => pure dk | none => StateT.lift (liftM SignalPqxdh.sampleDRKey96) let entry := { sessEntry with drKeyRand := drKeyRand } StateT.lift (set { st with sessions := entry :: st.sessions, roCache := roCache' }) modify fun ds => { ds with initTapes := (sid, u, bundle, t_init) :: ds.initTapes } match SignalPqxdh.findHonestPrincipal P st.principals bundle.ikB with | some _ => return .hdrResp hdr | none => return .initUnfreshResp drKeyReal hdr

def bhDrvKeyIndL564–620 ↗#

KeyInd oracle handler for the composed driver (DEV-C12, DEV-C15, DEV-C19, DEV-PQ6, DEV-PQ13): at useRo = false, .initPrin u samples a single scalar shared by X25519 and XEdDSA (secIKAsign := secIKA0, matching libsignal's one-key identities, DEV-PQ13), and .corruptIK u is refused while bhNoOpkRespPromoted ds.instMeta u holds.

def bhDrvKeyInd (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (P : SignalPqxdh.Primitives) (useRo : Bool := false) : QueryImpl (SignalPqxdh.keyIndSpec S) (BHDrvM S ℓ) := fun q => match q with | .testSession _ | .revealDhSecrets => return .noneResp | .initPrin u => do let r ← if !useRo then StateT.lift (do let st ← get if st.principals.any (fun (idx, _) => idx == u.val) then return .noneResp let secIKA0 ← liftM SignalPqxdh.sampleScalar32 let ikAPk := P.x25519Base secIKA0 let entry : SignalPqxdh.PrincipalEntry := { secIKA0 := secIKA0, ikAPk := ikAPk, secIKAsign := secIKA0, ikSignPk := ikAPk, corrupted := false } set { st with principals := (u.val, entry) :: st.principals } return .initPrinResp ikAPk ikAPk) else StateT.lift (SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl useRo S P (.initPrin u)) modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.initPrin u) r); return r | .initiateOPK u i bnd => do let ds ← get if bnd.opkB?.isNone || !bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds.toModelDriverBase bnd then return .noneResp let r ← bhRunInitiate S P (.sendOPK u i) u bnd useRo modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.initiateOPK u i bnd) r); return r | .initiateNoOPK u i bnd => do let ds ← get if bnd.opkB?.isSome || !bhDrvInitiateIkOk P ds.toModelDriverBase bnd then return .noneResp let r ← bhRunInitiate S P (.sendNoOPK u i) u bnd useRo modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.initiateNoOPK u i bnd) r); return r | .acceptOPK k j o hdr => do let ds ← get if !bhDrvAcceptIkOk ds.toModelDriverBase hdr then return .noneResp let r ← StateT.lift (SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl useRo S P (.acceptOPK k j o hdr)) modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.acceptOPK k j o hdr) r); return r | .acceptNoOPK k j l hdr => do let ds ← get if !bhDrvAcceptIkOk ds.toModelDriverBase hdr then return .noneResp let r ← StateT.lift (SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl useRo S P (.acceptNoOPK k j l hdr)) modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.acceptNoOPK k j l hdr) r); return r | .roQuery secrets => do let st ← StateT.lift get let (dk, roCache') ← StateT.lift (liftM (SignalPqxdh.evalHkdfOrRo useRo P st.roCache secrets)) StateT.lift (set { st with roCache := roCache' }) return .drKeyResp dk | .corruptIK u => do let ds ← get if bhNoOpkRespPromoted ds.instMeta u then return .noneResp let r ← StateT.lift (SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl useRo S P (.corruptIK u)) modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds (.corruptIK u) r); return r | q => do let r ← StateT.lift (SignalPqxdh.pqxdhKeyIndImpl useRo S P q) modify (fun ds => bhDrvMirror ds q r); return r

def bhIsBobRecvSMQueryL622–625 ↗#

Whether an SM query is deliver-B or inject-B.

def bhIsBobRecvSMQuery {ℓ : ℕ} {PQC : Type} : (cliGameSmSpec ℓ PQC).Domain → Bool | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, _))) | .inl (.inr (.B, _)) => true | _ => false

def bhIsBobAcceptSMRespL627–632 ↗#

Whether a deliver-B or inject-B query returned some (.accepted ..).

def bhIsBobAcceptSMResp {St : Type} {ℓ : ℕ} {PQC : Type} : (q : (SM.spec St (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes).Domain) → (SM.spec St (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes).Range q → Bool | .inl (.inl (.inr (.B, _))), some (.accepted _ _ _) => true | .inl (.inr (.B, _)), some (.accepted _ _ _) => true | _, _ => false

def bhMetaAfterSML634–640 ↗#

Record bobAccepted and ikACorrAtAccept on Bob's first accepted message (DEV-C17).

def bhMetaAfterSM {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} {PQC : Type} (ds : ModelDriverState S ℓ) (bi : ModelDriverInstance S ℓ) (im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S) (q : (cliGameSmSpec ℓ PQC).Domain) (r : (cliGameSmSpec ℓ PQC).Range q) : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S := if !im.bobAccepted && bhIsBobAcceptSMResp q r then { im with bobAccepted := true, ikACorrAtAccept := bhInstIkACorrupted ds bi } else im

Wire-to-model adapter interfaces and cost budgets

def bhGameSpecL644–646 ↗#

Non-coin game oracle interface over wire-byte party state BinState.

@[reducible] def bhGameSpec (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (PQC : Type) := SignalPqxdh.keyIndSpec S + bhDrCtlSpec S + cliGameDrSpec ℓ PQC

def bhModelDrSpecWithSpqrL648–650 ↗#

@[reducible] def bhModelDrSpecWithSpqr (ℓ : ℕ) (PQC : Type) : OracleSpec (ℕ × (SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes).Domain) := fun x => (SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes).Range x.2

def bhTargetGameSpecL652–654 ↗#

Non-coin game oracle interface over model party state GhostState Bytes.

@[reducible] def bhTargetGameSpec (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (PQC : Type) := SignalPqxdh.keyIndSpec S + bhDrCtlSpec S + bhModelDrSpecWithSpqr ℓ PQC

def bhCtlUnStartL656–657 ↗#

def bhCtlUnStart {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} : BHDRCtlQuery S → SignalPqxdh.SessionId S | .startDR sid => sid

def e2eTargetGameCodecL659–661 ↗#

@[reducible] def e2eTargetGameCodec (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (Pt : Type := Empty) : ReductionDsl.GameCodec (ReductionDsl.atomicSig ℓ Pt) (bhTargetGameSpec S ℓ (BitVec 512)) := ReductionDsl.e2eGameCodec S ℓ Pt bhCtlUnStart

def e2eBhAdapterIfaceL663–665 ↗#

@[reducible] def e2eBhAdapterIface (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (Pt : Type := Empty) : ReductionDsl.Iface (ReductionDsl.atomicSig ℓ Pt) (unifSpec + bhTargetGameSpec S ℓ (BitVec 512)) := ReductionDsl.e2eAdapterIface S ℓ Pt BHDRCtlQuery.startDR

def e2eBhAdapterCodecL667–669 ↗#

@[reducible] def e2eBhAdapterCodec (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) (Pt : Type := Empty) : ReductionDsl.GameCodec (ReductionDsl.atomicSig ℓ Pt) (bhGameSpec S ℓ (BitVec 512)) := ReductionDsl.e2eAdapterCodec S ℓ Pt bhCtlUnStart

abbrev CliToModelAdapterProgL671–676 ↗#

ReductionDsl.CostedReduction program type for the wire-to-model (BinState to GhostState Bytes) game adapter.

abbrev CliToModelAdapterProg (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (ℓ : ℕ) {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) := ReductionDsl.CostedReduction (ReductionDsl.atomicAdapterOps ℓ decT encT) (e2eBhAdapterIface S ℓ Pt) (bhGameSpec S ℓ (BitVec 512)) (e2eBhAdapterCodec S ℓ Pt) .unit .unit .bool .bool

def bhQueryKindL678–684 ↗#

Query-kind classifier shared by bhGameSpec and bhTargetGameSpec: offline KeyInd random-oracle queries (.roQuery) have kind 1, and all online queries (non-RO KeyInd, startDR, and per-instance SM) have kind 0.

def bhQueryKind {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ι : Type} : (SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S ⊕ BHDRCtlQuery S) ⊕ ι → Fin 2 | .inl (.inl (.roQuery _)) => 1 | _ => 0

def bhKindCountsL686–691 ↗#

Per-kind query budgets under bhQueryKind: kind 0 bounds online queries (min b.q_on b.q_total non-RO KeyInd queries plus qStart promotions and qDR SM queries), and kind 1 bounds offline .roQuery calls (min b.q_ro b.q_total).

def bhKindCounts (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR : ℕ) : Fin 2 → ℕ | 0 => min b.q_on b.q_total + qStart + qDR | 1 => min b.q_ro b.q_total

def bhAdapterCostBudgetL693–705 ↗#

Step-cost budget for a CliToModelAdapterProg, clamping mirrored KeyInd table sizes at min b.q_total S.N_*.

def bhAdapterCostBudget (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let M_id := min b.q_total S.N_id let M_spk := min b.q_total S.N_spk_tot let M_opk := min b.q_total S.N_opk_tot let M_send := min b.q_total S.N_send_tot 2 ^ 6 * (b.q_total + qStart + qDR + 1) * (2 * M_id + 56 * M_spk + 3 * M_opk + 2 * M_send + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_id + 8 * Nat.log 2 S.N_spk_tot + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_opk_tot + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_send_tot + 4 * qStart + 4 * ℓ + 2 ^ 12)

def bhAdapterCostBudgetByKindL707–727 ↗#

Per-kind step-cost budget for a CliToModelAdapterProg under bhQueryKind: clamps mirrored KeyInd table sizes at the online count M_on = min b.q_on b.q_total and charges a constant 2 ^ 12 per offline .roQuery call (M_ro = min b.q_ro b.q_total), since offline hash queries are forwarded without mutating adapter tables. The proofs meet this with cliToModelAdapterProgTblRo, whose .ki arm sends .roQuery around the base-state mirror update; cliToModelAdapterProgTblRo_eval_eq proves it has the same eval as cliToModelAdapterProgTbl (Proofs/E2E/Dsl/CliAdapterTblByKind.lean).

def bhAdapterCostBudgetByKind (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let M_on := min b.q_on b.q_total let M_ro := min b.q_ro b.q_total let M_id := min M_on S.N_id let M_spk := min M_on S.N_spk_tot let M_opk := min M_on S.N_opk_tot let M_send := min M_on S.N_send_tot 2 ^ 6 * (M_on + qStart + qDR + 1) * (2 * M_id + 56 * M_spk + 3 * M_opk + 2 * M_send + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_id + 8 * Nat.log 2 S.N_spk_tot + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_opk_tot + 2 * Nat.log 2 S.N_send_tot + 4 * qStart + 4 * ℓ + 2 ^ 12) + 2 ^ 12 * M_ro

def CliAdapterForwardsKindsL729–738 ↗#

Kind-preservation predicate on a wire-to-model adapter L: if the source adversary makes at most qKind i queries of kind i under bhQueryKind for every i, so does L.eval A ().

def CliAdapterForwardsKinds {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} {Pt : Type} {decT : PublicKey → Option Pt} {encT : Pt → PublicKey} (L : CliToModelAdapterProg S ℓ decT encT) (qKind : Fin 2 → ℕ) : Prop := ∀ (A : Unit → OracleComp (unifSpec + bhGameSpec S ℓ (BitVec 512)) Bool), (∀ a i, (A a).IsQueryBoundP (fun t => SignalPqxdh.isGameQueryOfKind bhQueryKind i t = true) (qKind i)) → ∀ i, (L.eval A ()).IsQueryBoundP (fun t => SignalPqxdh.isGameQueryOfKind bhQueryKind i t = true) (qKind i)

def CliAdapterCostBoundedL740–752 ↗#

Total and per-kind step-cost, query-count, size-honesty, and kind-preservation bounds on a wire-to-model adapter L, combining GRedBounded at bhAdapterCostBudget, GRedCostByKind at bhAdapterCostBudgetByKind, and CliAdapterForwardsKinds under bhKindCounts b qStart qDR.

def CliAdapterCostBounded {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} {Pt : Type} (decT : PublicKey → Option Pt) (encT : Pt → PublicKey) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR : ℕ) (L : CliToModelAdapterProg S ℓ decT encT) : Prop := let qTot := b.q_total + qStart + qDR let qKind := bhKindCounts b qStart qDR GRedBounded L (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 0) qTot qTot (bhAdapterCostBudget S b qStart qDR ℓ) ∧ GRedCostByKind L (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 0) bhQueryKind qKind (List.ofFn qKind).sum (bhAdapterCostBudgetByKind S b qStart qDR ℓ) ∧ CliAdapterForwardsKinds L qKind

Query budgets, model-state driver, and composition cost budgets

def bhE2EMirrorL861–870 ↗#

Mirror a KeyInd query/response pair into BHE2EDrvState.

def bhE2EMirror {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (q : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndQuery S) (r : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ := let base' := bhBaseMirror σ.toModelDriverBase q r let corr' := match q, r with | .corruptIK u, .corrResp _ _ => u :: σ.corrPrins | _, _ => σ.corrPrins let revSpks' := match q, r with | .revealSpkSk u j, .spkSkResp _ => (u, j) :: σ.revealedSpks | _, _ => σ.revealedSpks { σ with toModelDriverBase := base', corrPrins := corr', revealedSpks := revSpks' }

def bhE2EDrvInstCleanL872–880 ↗#

Per-instance cleanliness check on BHE2EDrvState (DEV-C17).

def bhE2EDrvInstClean {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (i : ℕ) : Bool := match σ.insts[i]?, σ.instMeta[i]? with | some d, some im => (bhDrvSessionInitPrin? d.sid).isSome && !im.ikACorrAtAccept && (match im.respPrin, im.respSpkIdx with | some u, some j => !σ.revealedSpks.contains (u, j) | _, _ => false) | _, _ => true

def bhE2EDrvWonL882–884 ↗#

Whether some promoted instance in σ with challenge bit b has gs.win = true.

def bhE2EDrvWon {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (b : Bool) : Bool := σ.insts.any (fun d => match d.gs with | some gs => gs.b == b && gs.win | none => false)

Session-promotion guard on BHE2EDrvState (DEV-C9, DEV-C10, DEV-C20), mirroring bhDrvGuard.

def bhE2EGuard {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) : Option (SignalPqxdh.HandshakeHdr × SignalPqxdh.PreKeyBundleInput × (Fin S.N_id × Fin S.N_recv)) := if σ.insts.any (fun d => d.sid == sid) then none else match σ.sends.find? (fun (s, _, _) => s == sid) with | none => none | some (_, bnd, hdr) => if σ.insts.any (fun d => d.hdr.ekAPk == hdr.ekAPk) then none else match σ.bundles.find? (fun ((_, j), (spkB, pqspkB)) => spkB == bnd.spkB && pqspkB == bnd.pqspkB && hdr.spkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val && hdr.pqspkId == UInt32.ofNat j.val) with | none => none | some ((u, j), _) => if σ.prins.any (fun (u', pk) => u' == u && pk == bnd.ikB) && bhBaseOpkOk σ.toModelDriverBase u j bnd && (bnd.opkB?.isSome || !σ.corrPrins.contains u) then some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)) else none

Whether the initiator identity key of d belongs to a corrupted principal in σ.

def bhE2EInstIkACorr {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (d : BHModelInst S ℓ) : Bool := (match bhDrvSessionInitPrin? d.sid with | some u => σ.corrPrins.contains u | none => true) || σ.prins.any (fun (u, pk) => pk == d.hdr.ikAPk && σ.corrPrins.contains u)

def bhE2EFinishStartSpkL986–1008 ↗#

Complete startDR sid on BHE2EDrvState from KeyInd responses (kr1, kr2) and Alice's ratchet seed aliceCoins.

def bhE2EFinishStartSpk {S : SignalPqxdh.Setup} {ℓ : ℕ} (C : Crypto) (K : LibsignalSpqrV1.MlKem) (bMode? : Option Bool) (σ : BHE2EDrvState S ℓ) (sid : SignalPqxdh.SessionId S) (kr1 kr2 : SignalPqxdh.KeyIndResponse) (aliceCoins : BitVec 256) : Option ℕ × BHE2EDrvState S ℓ := match bhE2EGuard σ sid, kr1, kr2 with | some (hdr, bnd, (u, j)), .drKeyResp dk, .spkSkResp spkSk => if dk.rootKey.length == 32 && dk.chainKey.length == 32 && dk.pqrKey.length == 32 && spkSk.length == 32 then let idA := bhIdKeyOf hdr.ikAPk; let idB := bhIdKeyOf bnd.ikB let spkCoins := bhBytesWord spkSk let kS : SampledSessionKey := bhKeySOf dk aliceCoins let spqr := LibsignalSpqrV1.spqrV1SessionUniformCoins C.F K let sch := sessionSchemeFixedSpk (paramsIdsWithSpqr C spqr idA idB) ℓ spkCoins let gs := bMode?.map (fun b => SM.initState sch.sendPart kS b) let inst : BHModelInst S ℓ := { sid, hdr, idA, idB, spkCoins, gs } let im : ModelDriverInstanceMeta S := { respPrin := some u, respSpkIdx := some j, instOpkId? := hdr.opkId? } (some σ.insts.length, { σ with insts := σ.insts ++ [inst], instMeta := σ.instMeta ++ [im] }) else (none, σ) | _, _, _ => (none, σ)

def bhE2ECostBudgetL1010–1024 ↗#

Step-cost budget for the model-state composition reductions, bounding per-query dispatch and clamped table scans (min b.q_total S.N_*, min qStart nSend) together with the post-game allTestedSessionsFresh pass.

def bhE2ECostBudget (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR qInst qep ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let nId := min b.q_total S.N_id let nSpk := min b.q_total S.N_spk_tot let nOpk := min b.q_total S.N_opk_tot let nSend := min b.q_total S.N_send_tot let nRecv := min b.q_total S.N_recv_tot let nInst := min qStart nSend 2 ^ 10 * (b.q_total + qStart + qDR + 1) * (b.q_total + nOpk + nInst + qInst + Nat.log 2 qep + 10 * (nId + nSpk + nSend + nRecv) + maxForwardJumps + ℓ + 1) + 2 ^ 13 * nInst * (nId + nSpk + nRecv + 1)

def bhE2ECostBudgetByKindL1026–1049 ↗#

Per-kind step-cost budget for the model-state composition reductions under bhQueryKind: clamps session and key table scans at the online count M_on = min b.q_on b.q_total (Q_on = M_on + qStart + qDR), adds logarithmic random-oracle table lookup/insert cost across at most M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1 entries (M_ro = min b.q_ro b.q_total), and retains the post-game allTestedSessionsFresh pass. The table term can pay for a balanced lookup-tree walk of O(bits K) steps per offline query, K = M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1; the current E2E proofs forward each .roQuery to the target game in O(bits M_on) steps, which roStep_mul_le_roTableTerm (Proofs/E2E/Dsl/PrefixRedHaltedByKind.lean) bounds by the table term.

def bhE2ECostBudgetByKind (S : SignalPqxdh.Setup) (b : SignalPqxdh.QueryBudget) (qStart qDR qInst qep ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ := let M_on := min b.q_on b.q_total let M_ro := min b.q_ro b.q_total let Q_on := M_on + qStart + qDR let nId := min M_on S.N_id let nSpk := min M_on S.N_spk_tot let nOpk := min M_on S.N_opk_tot let nSend := min M_on S.N_send_tot let nRecv := min M_on S.N_recv_tot let nInst := min qStart nSend 2 ^ 10 * (Q_on + 1) * (M_on + nOpk + nInst + qInst + Nat.log 2 qep + 10 * (nId + nSpk + nSend + nRecv) + maxForwardJumps + ℓ + 1) + 2 ^ 13 * (M_ro + Q_on) * (ReductionDsl.bits (M_ro + 2 * Q_on + 1) + 4) + 2 ^ 13 * nInst * (nId + nSpk + nRecv + 1)

def GRed2BoundedL1051–1078 ↗#

Step-cost, program-size, query-count, size-honesty, and run-local block-width bound on a ReductionDsl.TwoStageCostedReduction: whenever every adversary game query and every target oracle answer on a run fits width B, the stage-1 checkpoint and stage-2 output fit 2 * (costBudget + q + 1) * (B + 1).

def GRed2Bounded {S : ReductionDsl.Sig} {O : ReductionDsl.Ops S} {ι κ : Type} {T : OracleSpec ι} {I : ReductionDsl.Iface S T} {G : OracleSpec κ} {C : ReductionDsl.GameCodec S G} {rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out : ReductionDsl.Ty S} (R : ReductionDsl.TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (wTag : I.Tag → ℕ) (wSamp : I.smp.Samp → ℕ) (q qOut costBudget : ℕ) (dflt : aOut.denote) : Prop := R.totalCost q ≤ costBudget ∧ R.size ≤ ReductionDsl.reductionSizeBudget + 2 ^ 12 * ReductionDsl.bits costBudget ∧ R.init.queries wTag wSamp + R.handlePre.queries wTag wSamp + R.chDone.queries wTag wSamp = 0 ∧ R.totalQueries wTag wSamp q ≤ qOut ∧ CostedOpsSizeHonest O ∧ CostedSampSizeHonest I.smp ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ), (∀ v : aOut.denote, CostedFits B aOut v) → ∀ (A : aIn.denote → OracleComp (unifSpec + G) aOut.denote), (∀ a, ReductionDsl.AllGameQueriesFit B C (A a)) → ∀ (x : rIn.denote), CostedFits B rIn x → let widthB := 2 * (costBudget + q + 1) * (B + 1) ∀ cm ∈ ReductionDsl.supportWhen (I.AnswerFits B) (R.eval1 A x q dflt), CostedFits widthB ch cm.1 ∧ ∀ (y : rIn2.denote), CostedFits B rIn2 y → ∀ z ∈ ReductionDsl.supportWhen (I.AnswerFits B) (R.eval2 cm.2 y q dflt), CostedFits widthB out z

def stageOneAsProbCompL1080–1089 ↗#

Evaluate a coin-only stage-1 computation in ProbComp by answering unused SM queries with bhModelSmDefault.

def stageOneAsProbComp {ℓ : ℕ} {PQC α : Type} (oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes) α) : ProbComp α := simulateQ (QueryImpl.ofLift unifSpec ProbComp + (fun q => pure (bhModelSmDefault q) : QueryImpl (SM.spec (GhostState Bytes) (Plain ℓ) PQC Bytes) ProbComp)) oa
end CryptoVerification.E2E
